expected_level_description: You can: - show an awareness of Agile methodology and the ways to apply the principles in practice - take an open-minded approach - explain why iteration is important - iterate quickly

You can: - choose the appropriate medium to communicate findings - shape and share communications relevant to the audience - present analysis and visualisations in clear ways to both specialist and non-specialist audiences, with support - give tactical recommendations based on your analysis and insight to inform decision making

You can: - explain how governance and assurance works - follow appropriate governance and assurance processes - contribute to deciding what governance and assurance is required for a product or service
You can: - understand the importance of planning and forecasting - show an awareness of the different ways to develop a plan

You can: - identify important stakeholders and communicate with them clearly and regularly - tailor communication to stakeholders' needs and work with them to build relationships while meeting user needs - build and reach consensus with stakeholders - work to improve stakeholder relationships using evidence to explain decisions
You can: - explain the strategic context of your work and why it is important - support strategic planning in an administrative capacity

You can: - explain the clinical and care workflows your work supports - use common health care terms correctly with clinical and care colleagues - recognise when a change could affect patient care and raise it
You can: - explain how health IT systems can harm patients, for example through wrong, missing, or delayed information - report a possible clinical safety issue through the right route
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly
You can: - maintain plans, risk and issue logs, and reports - run project meetings and track actions - manage a small, well-defined project with support
You can: - record and update risks for your area - suggest controls and track actions
